dataset_name: Northern Santa Cruz FEMA map-class terrain sample
dataset_role: geographically external test set for existing terrain FEMA classifiers
target_meaning: FEMA NFHL mapped annual-chance class; not observed event flooding
sampling: Area-weighted FEMA polygon selection; random point in a 10 m inward buffer; require unique class, at least 30 m between samples, complete local raster values, and a legacy local water feature within 5 km. The legacy eligibility rule preserves the original 450 locations; nearest-water distance is then corrected with USGS 3DHP flowlines.
limitations: FEMA map labels are not observed floods or verified dry event outcomes. Balanced spatial samples do not represent natural class prevalence. The original point eligibility used a Bay-centered hydrography layer, so the sample favors locations within 5 km of that legacy layer even though stored distances use the augmented 3DHP network. Narrow 0.2% zones may cluster despite 30 m separation; use this region as one holdout, not random row splits.
